+    def test_order_by_multiline_sql(self):
+        # Test that multiline RawSQL in order_by clauses are not incorrectly
+        # deduplicated. Regression test for issue where multiline RawSQL
+        # clauses with identical last lines were treated as duplicates.
+        mary = Employee.objects.create(firstname='Mary', lastname='Mustermann', salary=20)
+        
+        # Create a query with multiple multiline RawSQL order_by clauses
+        # that have similar but not identical content
+        qs = Employee.objects.all().order_by(
+            RawSQL(
+                """
+                case when salary > 15
+                     then 2 else 1 end""", []
+            ).desc(),
+            RawSQL(
+                """
+                case when salary > 15
+                     then salary
+                     else 0 end""", []
+            ).asc(),
+            RawSQL(
+                """
+                case when salary < 15
+                     then salary
+                     else 0 end""", []
+            ).desc()
+        )
+        
+        # Execute the query to ensure all order_by clauses are included
+        # If the bug exists, the third clause would be removed as a duplicate
+        result = list(qs)
+        self.assertEqual(len(result), 4)  # Should have all 4 employees
+        
+        # Verify the SQL contains all three case statements
+        sql = str(qs.query)
+        case_count = sql.count('case when')
+        self.assertEqual(case_count, 3, 
+            f"Expected 3 'case when' clauses in SQL, but found {case_count}")
